name: Game of SKATE
author: Skate3clone
description: One skater sets a trick. Everyone else has to match it or take a letter. Last player without SKATE wins. Works solo as a set-then-match drill.

copy_seconds.label: Copy window (seconds)
copy_seconds.description: How long copiers have to match the set trick before taking a letter.

allow_ollie.label: Allow ollie as a set
allow_ollie.description: If off, ollies and nollies cannot start a round.
